sections.name: Struggle
sections.description: The carry struggle, 30 frames at the source rate for a 1.00s cycle. Range picked by _strugloop.js: the seam between frame 65 and frame 36 measures 5.32 against a mean adjacent-frame distance of 13.08, so looping back is a smaller visual step than the animation makes on its own. Every frame at the source rate — the export duplicates poses in pairs (the artist's own timing) and those duplicates are kept, because dropping them is what made the walk read as a limp.
